name: devops-e2e-platform
description: Complete DevOps E2E platform with microservices architecture

scripts.install:all: npm run install:services && npm run install:infrastructure
scripts.install:services: cd services/api-gateway && npm install && cd ../auth-service && npm install && cd ../user-service && npm install && cd ../order-service && npm install
scripts.install:infrastructure: echo 'Infrastructure dependencies will be installed during deployment'
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:api-gateway" "npm run dev:auth-service" "npm run dev:user-service" "npm run dev:order-service"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:api-gateway && npm run test:auth-service && npm run test:user-service && npm run test:order-service
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint:api-gateway && npm run lint:auth-service && npm run lint:user-service && npm run lint:order-service
scripts.build:all: npm run build:api-gateway && npm run build:auth-service && npm run build:user-service && npm run build:order-service
scripts.security:scan: npm run security:scan:api-gateway && npm run security:scan:auth-service && npm run security:scan:user-service && npm run security:scan:order-service
scripts.format:all: npm run format:api-gateway && npm run format:auth-service && npm run format:user-service && npm run format:order-service
scripts.setup:db: npm run setup:db:migrations && npm run setup:db:seeds
scripts.setup:db:migrations: echo 'Database migrations will be run during deployment'
scripts.setup:db:seeds: echo 'Database seeds will be run during deployment'

author: DevOps E2E Team
